items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And God Louis loved Zutty. ... he knew Zutt y loved him and he loved Zutt y.

ctx.x: But when he came to California they were babies really. Just, well one of them was a baby in arms when he came. The other two were just toddlers. Now they are grown up and have families of
their own. We saw one boy in California when Zutt went out there to play for the Berkeley colleges you know.
Well Marge, were you more of a soloist or did you sort of really remain like a band pianist? And what happened to you?
